newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gajah Surya bank acquisition approved.
newsitem.headline: Gajah Surya bank acquisition approved.

text.p: Shareholders of Indonesian finance firm PT Gajah Surya have approved a proposal for the acquisition of a 51.8 percent stake in Bank Dagang Nasional Indonesia (BDNI), the Jakarta Post reported on Tuesday.
The shareholders, at a meeting on Monday, also approved a rights issue to finance the acquisition, which has been valued at between 734.2 billion rupiah and 808.7 billion rupiah, the newspaper said.

Gajah Surya, a unit of the Gajah Tunggal group, will issue seven new shares for every two held at a price of 1,300 rupiah each, the newspaper said. Proceeds will amount to around 728 million rupiah, the company has said.
Gajah Surya shares closed at 1,400 rupiah on Monday and BDNI at 1,675.
